tasks.label: Gradle: runIde
tasks.detail: Republishes the LSP server (only if src/LSP or src/Core changed — see publishServer's Gradle inputs in build.gradle.kts) and launches a sandboxed Rider instance with the plugin loaded.

tasks.label: Gradle: runIde (debug)
tasks.detail: Same as 'Gradle: runIde', but passes Gradle's --debug-jvm flag, which suspends the sandbox JVM on debug port 5005 until a debugger attaches. Run this task first, wait for the terminal to print 'Listening for transport dt_socket at address: 5005', then press F5 (Attach to Rider sandbox) to connect and set Kotlin breakpoints.
